articles.title: U.S. confirms $700 million NASAMS sale to Taiwan amid rising tensions with China
articles.summary: The U.S. confirmed a $698.9 million deal to supply Taiwan with three National Advanced Surface-to-Air Missile Systems (NASAMS). These medium-range defense systems are proven effective against drones, significantly bolstering Taiwan's air defense capabilities. This deal underscores ongoing efforts to enhance the island nation's security amidst rising geopolitical tensions, providing a crucial deterrent.
